CustomField.description: Last activity associated with this Account occurred this many days ago
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(LastActivityDate_Account__c) && ISBLANK(LastActivityDate_Lead__c), NULL, IF( ISBLANK(LastActivityDate_Account__c), TODAY() - LastActivityDate_Lead__c, IF( ISBLANK(LastActivityDate_Lead__c), TODAY() - LastActivityDate_Account__c, MIN( TODAY() - LastActivityDate_Account__c, TODAY() - LastActivityDate_Lead__c ) ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Last activity on Account occurred this many days ago
CustomField.label: Days Since Last Activity
